cues.en: I'm sure you've heard this term before, entropy, or I'm sure you've seen this word written down.
cues.zh: 你一定聽過 entropy，也就是熵，或者至少看過這個字。

cues.en: The concept of entropy has different meanings, different interpretations in different areas of science.
cues.zh: 熵在不同科學領域，有不同意義與解讀。

cues.en: So, for example, in physics, the term entropy comes from or is related to the second law of thermodynamics.
cues.zh: 例如，在物理學裡，熵來自，或與熱力學第二定律有關。

cues.en: And it's basically the idea that stuff in the universe matter in the universe naturally goes from a
cues.zh: 基本概念是，宇宙裡的東西、物質，自然會從，

cues.en: state of order to a state of disorder, and this means that we will all die in the universe, will decay into nothingness.
cues.zh: 有序走向無序；這表示我們都會死亡，而宇宙會衰敗成虛無。

cues.en: Well, it's a rather grim, depressing thought, but unfortunately that is simply the truth.
cues.zh: 這個想法相當陰鬱、令人沮喪，但可惜，這就是事實。

cues.en: Now we are actually in deep learning.
cues.zh: 不過，在深度學習裡，

cues.en: We're not concerned with this interpretation of entropy.
cues.zh: 我們不關心這種熵的解讀方式。

cues.en: Instead, we are going to be using a different kind of entropy, which is named after this gentleman here, Claude Shannon.
cues.zh: 我們要使用另一種熵，以這位先生 Claude Shannon 的名字命名。

cues.en: He was a real genius and made a lot of important contributions to signal processing and computer science and cryptography.
cues.zh: 他是真正的天才，對訊號處理、電腦科學和密碼學，都有很多重要貢獻。

cues.en: And Shannon entropy is a measure.
cues.zh: Shannon 熵是一種衡量指標。

cues.en: It's a quantity that describes the amount of surprise or uncertainty that we have about a specific variable.
cues.zh: 它描述我們對某個特定變數，感到多驚訝，或有多少不確定性。

cues.en: And in particular, entropy is maximal at probabilities of 0.5.
cues.zh: 尤其，當機率是零點五時，熵會達到最大。

cues.en: So this is when things when events are maximally uncertain or unpredictable.
cues.zh: 也就是事件最不確定、最無法預測的時候。

cues.en: And as the events get more predictable, either that you know we are the probability goes down to zero.
cues.zh: 隨著事件變得更容易預測，例如機率降到零，

cues.en: So this event never happens or the probability goes up to one that this event always happens, then that decreases the amount of entropy.
cues.zh: 表示事件從不發生；或升到一，表示事件總會發生，熵都會減少。

cues.en: So this is called information theoretic entropy or it's also called Shannon entropy.
cues.zh: 這叫做資訊理論中的熵，也叫 Shannon 熵。

cues.en: And it means that yeah everything is great and happy.
cues.zh: 它意味著，一切都很棒、很快樂。

cues.en: And we're going to have great wonderful lives and that That's surprising.
cues.zh: 我們會有美好的人生，而且，令人驚訝的，

cues.en: Things convey more information now.
cues.zh: 事情會傳遞更多資訊。

cues.en: I also want to briefly discuss this term surprise, because the word surprise also has different meanings in different areas of language, different contexts.
cues.zh: 也想簡短討論 surprise 這個詞，因為驚訝在不同語言情境裡，也有不同意義。

cues.en: In the context of information theory, surprise means the amount of predictability or uncertainty.
cues.zh: 在資訊理論裡，surprise 指的是可預測或不確定的程度。

cues.en: So we might think that, you know, if you flip a coin and it lands on heads 99 times, then you flip it 100th time and it lands on tails, that might be pretty surprising.
cues.zh: 例如，你可能覺得，擲硬幣連續九十九次都是正面，第一百次卻是反面，會很令人驚訝。

cues.en: But in terms of entropy, that's actually not a lot of surprise in the system altogether.
cues.zh: 但從熵的角度看，整個系統其實沒有太多驚訝。

cues.en: That one event might be surprising to us humans, but the system of 99 heads and one tail actually has
cues.zh: 那一次事件對人類來說也許很驚訝，但九十九次正面、一次反面的系統，

cues.en: very little surprise the system altogether, because the probability of tails is very small.
cues.zh: 整體的驚訝程度很低，因為反面發生的機率很小。

cues.en: Actually.
cues.zh: 其實，

cues.en: Now I forget if I was saying 99 heads or 99 tails, but I think you get the idea.
cues.zh: 我忘了剛才說的是九十九次正面還是反面，但你應該懂意思。

cues.en: So the idea is that entropy is maximal when probabilities are chance level and entropies are minimal

cues.en: as probabilities go to zero or to one, indicating that we have a lot of certainty, a lot of predictability about the particular event.
cues.zh: 表示對特定事件有很高的確定性與可預測性。

cues.zh: 這裡是熵的公式。

cues.en: So we have three terms in this formula X which is the data values p which is the probability of those values occurring.
cues.zh: 公式裡有三個部分：x 是資料值，p 是那些值出現的機率。

cues.zh: 接著還有對數。

cues.zh: 把事件發生的機率，乘上同一個機率的對數。

cues.en: So this term here is exactly the same as this term.
cues.zh: 所以這裡這一項，和那一項完全相同。

cues.zh: 對每種可能事件，都計算機率乘上該機率的對數。

cues.en: So the probability of heads times the log of the probability of heads plus the the probability of tails
cues.zh: 正面的機率乘上正面機率的對數，再加反面的機率，

cues.en: times the log of the probability of tails, we sum those values together.
cues.zh: 乘上反面機率的對數；把這些值加起來。

cues.en: If we take the minus sign and entropy is typically indicated using the capital letter H, the minus
cues.zh: 最後加上負號；熵通常用大寫 H 表示。這個負號，

cues.en: sign here is because probability values go between 0 and 1, and the log of A, a number between 0 and 1 is negative.
cues.zh: 是因為機率在零到一之間，而零到一之間數字的對數是負數。

cues.zh: 所以這整個量會是負的。

cues.zh: 我們把符號反過來變成正數，比較容易解讀。

cues.zh: 這就是熵的公式。

cues.en: Now I just want to briefly discuss interpreting entropy.
cues.zh: 現在簡短談談如何解讀熵。

cues.en: So a system a collection with high entropy means that the data set has a lot of variability.
cues.zh: 一個系統或集合的熵很高，表示資料集有很高的變異程度。

cues.en: Likewise, or conversely, low entropy means that most of the values in the data set repeat and are therefore redundant.
cues.zh: 相反地，熵低表示資料集裡大多數值都重複，因此有冗餘。

cues.en: So there's less surprise, There's more predictability of the system.
cues.zh: 驚訝比較少，系統也更容易預測。
